title: Prism
decision: When is a model good enough?
summary: A deterministic, simulated workbench for evaluating task-specific tradeoffs with inspectable metrics and a static evidence explorer.

capabilities.label: Synthetic evaluations
capabilities.detail: Runs fixed, owner-reviewed synthetic cases through deterministic fixture profiles; no live provider is available.

capabilities.label: Reproducible metrics
capabilities.detail: Uses content-addressed records, deterministic aggregation, and explicit small-sample uncertainty guardrails.

capabilities.label: Static result explorer
capabilities.detail: Exports eight redacted artifacts into a prerendered explorer with route-level access to aggregate and case evidence.

evidence.description: The documented offline fixture run validates, executes, verifies, computes metrics, and exports the static evidence set.
The threat model records simulated-only, name-guard, redaction, digest, and uncertainty protections.
Git-sourced production deployment verified through hosted smoke tests.
